EventConfig.title: EventConfig
EventConfig.description: Global event parameters and automatic PDF credential customization settings managed by the administrator.

subtitle.description: Optional subtitle or organizer name printed on the PDF.

gameDurationSeconds.description: Duration of the arcade game round in seconds (10 to 120).

badgeTitle.description: Custom header title displayed on printed/PDF credentials.

badgeAccentColor.description: Custom hex accent color for credentials and diplomas.

badgeFooterNote.description: Custom footer message displayed on credentials and diplomas.

whatsappTemplate.description: Custom message template used when sending credentials via WhatsApp.

pdfShowQr.description: Whether the generated PDF credential includes the QR verification code.

pdfShowRoleOrg.description: Whether the generated PDF credential includes the attendee role and organization.

pdfShowScore.description: Whether the generated PDF credential includes the arcade game score.

pdfShowPrize.description: Whether the generated PDF credential includes Tombola prize info (false by default since Tombola is Admin-managed).

pdfAutoDownloadOnCheckIn.description: Whether a PDF credential is automatically generated and downloaded upon registration.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last configuration update.

Prize.title: Prize
Prize.description: Prize item in the Admin Tombola wheel.

color.description: Hex color for the wheel sector.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last prize update.

Attendee.title: Attendee
Attendee.description: Public event attendee record (PII-free) for leaderboard, arcade score, and admin-assigned prize.

authorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who created the registration.

role.description: Profile or area of the attendee.

organization.description: Company or institution of the attendee.

wordForCloud.description: Single motivation word for the live word cloud.

arcadeScore.description: Best score achieved in the mobile-first arcade game.

playedArcade.description: Whether the attendee has completed at least one arcade round.

prizeWon.description: Prize assigned exclusively by the Admin via the Tombola wheel.

isPublic.description: Flag indicating the attendee record is visible on the event leaderboard.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update.

AttendeeContact.title: AttendeeContact
AttendeeContact.description: Isolated PII contact record storing the optional WhatsApp phone number, readable only by the owner or Admin.

authorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

phone.description: Optional WhatsApp phone number in international or local format.

EventHistory.title: EventHistory
EventHistory.description: Archived snapshot of a completed event session saved before clearing the active session.

eventName.description: Name of the archived event session.

venue.description: Venue of the archived event session.

attendeeCount.description: Total number of registered attendees in the session.

topScore.description: Highest arcade score recorded in the session.

topPlayerName.description: Name of the top scoring player.

prizesAwardedCount.description: Number of prizes awarded during the session.

attendeesSummary.description: Compact summary list of attendees, scores, and prizes for historical reporting.

/eventConfig/{configId}.description: Stores the global event settings and automatic PDF credential customization.

/prizes/{prizeId}.description: Stores the prize tiers and stock for the Admin Tombola.

/attendees/{attendeeId}.description: Stores public registered attendees, their arcade scores, and admin-assigned prizes.

/attendeeContacts/{attendeeId}.description: Isolated PII storage for optional WhatsApp numbers (owner and admin access only).

/eventHistory/{historyId}.description: Stores archived event sessions saved by the administrator.
